search_notes: Frozen cutoff: September 7, 2026, inclusive; September 7 game reports are included because no intraday cutoff was specified. Selected six items with explicit publication dates visible in search-indexed source text, covering current standings, remaining games and direct matchups, the tiebreaker, and pitching strengths and weaknesses. No betting pages, odds, market prices, or post-cutoff developments are included. A Yahoo magic-number article was excluded because its displayed publication date was September 9 despite a September 7 title. Dynamic standings and season-summary pages were excluded. web_fetch failed because multiple providers were registered; the requested agent-reach fallback returned a rate-limit error, so evidence verification relied on web_search's indexed article text and visible dates rather than successful direct page retrieval.
